people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
translations.bsb: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
translations.kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
translations.asv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus, and thou shalt be saved, thou and thy house.
